# AUDIO PROFILE
Sandra, a working-class woman from Bolton, Lancashire in her fifties, married to Derek for thirty years.

## THE SCENE
A vast, silent, spotless white room. The hundred survivors in white suits stand close around a giant rainbow-sheened silicon wafer the size of a house, the time machine, and understand for the first time what it will cost them. Utter hush, no echo; voices close, quiet and full of feeling.

### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Emotion for this line: small and frightened for once, no sarcasm at all; quiet, straight to the robot, almost a child's question.
Style: no sarcasm, no jab: for once she is small and frightened, asking the one thing she needs to know; quiet and close to the microphone.
Pace: three soft words, unhurried.
Accent: Northern English, as heard in Lancashire, around Bolton. Never American, never Received Pronunciation.

### SAMPLE CONTEXT
The voice you'd cast as the wife in a British sitcom row that the whole street can hear.
